title: Canonical comparison for the pro-etale stratum internal Hom
statement:
For a finite commutative coefficient ring A and a locally closed immersion s = j i into a Noetherian pro-etale scheme X, the K-flat/K-injective tensor-Hom, projection, and adjunction construction yields a natural transformation from

`RHom_X(Rs_!(-), -)`

to `Rs_* RHom_S(-, Rs^!(-))`; every component of this canonical transformation is an isomorphism. The final packaging as a natural isomorphism is performed by the parent node.

proof.text: Choose K-flat representatives for tensor variables and K-injective representatives for the internal Hom variable. Apply Hom-complex currying, the open and closed projection comparisons, the shriek adjunction, and the direct-image adjunction to define the comparison. Naturality descends from the representative maps. The inverse projection comparisons give a two-sided inverse for every component.

proof_origin.note: The theorem isolates the canonical componentwise comparison before NatIso.ofComponents packaging.
